body.name: \mathcal H_{\mathrm{gap}}
body.construction: Along sequences for which \(\sigma_r(M_K)\downarrow0\), \(\sigma_{r+1}(M_K)=0\), and all larger nonzero singular values remain separated, use the local experiment generated by the orthogonal cell influences \(\phi_c\). Calibrate \(\widehat r\) by singular-value thresholding at the observable cell-score noise scale. Compare the selected-rank plug-in with a Tikhonov inverse calibrated at the same scale while retaining \(y(M_K)_r^+B\) as the target and covering its regularization bias. For impossibility, compare two contiguous observed-data paths that differ in the colliding singular direction and separate the transported target.
